test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Consider two wires of the same material, but the ratio of their cross-sectional areas is 1 ∶ 10 and the ratio of their lengths is 2 ∶ 5. If the same 10 V battery is connected across these two wires separately, what will be the ratio of the current flow in these two wires?
